class_legend.V: vendor step kept in the minimal HS-only subset
class_legend.M-omit: vendor step omitted from the minimal subset (reason in omitted)
class_legend.U: platform state or step the loader cannot know; listed in unknowns

steps.what: pd_hsi0 power domain node: PMU window 0x12862000 (0x20 bytes), CMU 0x17800000, DTZPC SMC register 0x17810204
DTZPC restore SMC after the domain power-on sequence (needs EL3 service; CONFIG_EXYNOS_PD_EL3=m in the vendor config)
vendor config: PD EL3 restore and CMU init are built (EL3 module, CMU init built in)
four USB supplies: vdd075 = s5_l2, vdd12 = s4_l4, vdd18 = l7, vdd33 = l11 (regulators of the board's PMICs, switched outside the USB block)
vendor LDO order when it controls them: vdd075, vdd12, vdd18, vdd33 (enable); not called from the utmi_init path
the call to exynos_usbdrd_ldo_control in the PHY probe/ init path is commented out; it runs only via exynos_usbdrd_ldo_external_control/manual_control
CMU_TOP base 0x22b20000 (the only CMU_TOP base constant in the pinned tree)
CMU_TOP mux CLKCMU_HSI0_USB32DRD select at CMU_TOP+0x10c8
CMU_TOP gate CLKCMU_HSI0_USB32DRD at CMU_TOP+0x20c4
CMU_TOP divider CLKCMU_HSI0_USB32DRD at CMU_TOP+0x18a8
CMU_HSI0 user mux for the TOP clock (PLL_CON0 at +0x640): the controller's sclk/ref path
CMU_HSI0 mux CLK_HSI0_USB32DRD (the DT's MOUT_CLK_HSI0_USB32DRD = ref and ext_xtal clock) at +0x1008
CMU_HSI0 divider CLK_HSI0_EUSB (eUSB APB/PHY control clock) at +0x1800
CMU_HSI0 gate EUSB_APB_CLK at +0x2010
Q-channel LINK (the DT 'aclk' gate GATE_USB32DRD_QCH_S_LINK) at +0x305c; QCH_EN is bit 0, CLK_REQ bit 1
Q-channel CTRL (+0x3054), EUSBCTL (+0x3058), EUSBPHY (+0x300c), SUBCTRL (+0x3060): USBCON/eUSB control blocks
QCH bit layout: LINK QCH_EN bit 0
S2MPU in front of HSI0 DMA masters (stage-2 memory protection; CMU gate exists, configuration lives in the secure/hypervisor world)
read pd_hsi0 status: PMU 0x12860000 + 0x2004, bit 0 = domain on (vendor hsi0_status sequence). Always-on PMU, safe to read
only if the domain is off: power on by writing HSI0_CONFIGURATION (PMU 0x12862000 bit 0 = 1)
then wait for HSI0_STATUS bit 0 = 1 (bounded wait in the loader)
vendor order in pmucal_local_enable: the on sequence first
then (first power-on after boot) the DTZPC SMC (0.02) and the cmu_init sequence below; later power-ons restore the saved registers instead (the 'save' sequence)
cmu_init: CLK_HSI0_NOC mux (CMU_HSI0 + 0x1000) bit 4 = 0
cmu_init: CLK_HSI0_RTCCLK mux (+0x1004) bit 4 = 0
cmu_init: CLK_HSI0_USB32DRD mux (+0x1008, the DT's MOUT_CLK_HSI0_USB32DRD = DWC3 ref and PHY ext_xtal) bit 4 = 1
cmu_init: CLK_HSI0_EUSB divider (+0x1800) low 5 bits = 1
cmu_init: HSI0_NOC user mux (+0x630, the DT 'bus' clock UMUX_CLKCMU_HSI0_NOC) bit 4 = 1
cmu_init: DP GTC user mux (+0x610) bit 4 = 1 (DisplayPort clock, not USB)
cmu_init: DP OSC user mux (+0x620) bit 4 = 1 (DisplayPort clock, not USB)
cmu_init: HSI0_USB32DRD user mux (+0x640, the clock coming from CMU_TOP's CLKCMU_HSI0_USB32DRD) bit 4 = 1
cmu_init: HSI0 controller option 0 (+0x800) bits [31:24] = 0xf1
cmu_init: SYSREG_HSI0 BUS_COMPONENT_DRCG_EN (0x17820000 + 0x104) = 0xffffffff
power off sequence (for the record): clears CONTROLLER_OPTION0 bit 24 first, then HSI0_CONFIGURATION bit 0
repeater_enable(true) first: calls the single registered repeater driver (I2C hsi2c_34): TUSB2E11 0x3e or PTN3222 0x4f
release PHY isolation: PMU 0x61c bit 0 set (pmu_offset 0x61c, mask BIT(0)); TCXO buffer mask only if DT gives one (it does not)
enable the PHY clocks (DT clocks ext_xtal = MOUT_CLK_HSI0_USB32DRD and aclk = GATE_USB32DRD_QCH_S_LINK)
USBCON link wrapper init (see 2.xx)
vendor comment: pipe3 detach 'should not be called for super-speed and doesn't seem to affect high-speed'; the call is commented out in utmi_init
eUSB2 PHY initiation (see 3.xx)
DT: PMU offset 0x61c, DP offset 0x620, mask index 0 (BIT(0) set by the driver)
driver turns the DT mask index into BIT()
phy_power_on and power_off bodies are compiled out (SKIP_DWC3_CORE_POWER_CONTROL is never defined): power_on is a no-op that returns 0
USBCON offsets: LINKCTRL 0x04
USBCON offsets: LINK_CLKRST 0x0c
USBCON offsets: UTMI_CTRL 0x10
USBCON offsets: HSP_MISC 0x114
LINKCTRL: disable q-channel qact for id0, bvalid, vbusvalid, linkgate; write after 500 us
LINKCTRL second write: force_qact = 1, bus_filter_bypass 0xf, sel_sof 1
pulse link_sw_rst (assert, 10 us, deassert)
UTMI_CTRL: force_bvalid and force_vbusvalid (device mode needs VBUS valid forced because the pad is not wired: is_not_vbus_pad = 1)
DT: is_not_vbus_pad = 1
hold phy_reset and utmi_port_reset with their override enables (RST_CTRL at eUSB ctrl+0x0000)
CMN_CTRL phy_cfg_rptr_mode = 1 (PHY expects an eUSB2 repeater on the pins)
19.2 MHz reference: ref_freq_sel = 0
19.2 MHz reference: pll_fb_div = 368 (PLLCFG0 at +0x08), pll_ref_div = 0 (PLLCFG1 at +0x0c)
yield workaround: pll_cpbias_cntrl = 0
TXTUNE fsls_vref_tune = 0 (EOP egress feature off)
phy_exynos_eusb_tune (DT hs_tune_param is status = disabled, so defaults)
TESTSE test_iddq = 0
phy_enable = 0 before the reset release
delay 10 us twice (after test_iddq release; after phy_reset release for REXT calibration)
release phy_reset
phy_enable = 1, then 1000 us, 28 us, 2500 us (T4/T5: PHY up, port reset sent on the eUSB lines)
wait 1000 us
wait 28 us
wait 2500 us
release utmi_port_reset and its override
eUSB ctrl offsets: RST_CTRL 0, CMN_CTRL 4, PLLCFG0 8, PLLCFG1 0xc, TXTUNE 0x14, TESTSE 0x20
DT: USBCON 0x178a0000, eUSB ctrl 0x178b0000, eUSB phy 0x178c0000, USBDP ctrl 0x178d0000, TCA 0x178e0000, DWC3 0x17900000
full vendor path for the SuperSpeed PHY: PIPE3 isolation release (PMU 0x61c as well, and 0x620 for DP), ready_to_pipe3, USBDP enable
ready_to_pipe3: force_pipe_en = 0, HSP_MISC set, link_pclk_sel = 1 (link pclk from the USBDP pipe clock)
USBDP enable in RAM mode downloads firmware to SRAM (snps-usbdp-ram-code.h), then sets sram_ext_ld_done
DT: combo PHY version 0x801, RAM mode
detach pipe3: force_pipe_en = 1, force_phystatus = 0, force_rxelecidle = 1 (LINKCTRL) and link_pclk_sel = 0 (link pclk from the suspend clock): the link then runs without a SuperSpeed PHY
detach pipe3 clock select
vendor-evidenced HS operation with the pipe3 PHY off: usb3_phy_control(off) calls pipe3_disable (detach + USBDP disable) while the USB2 port stays in use
pipe3_disable body: detach then USBDP disable
DisplayPort 4-lane mode takes the combo PHY lanes: the xHCI glue calls dp_use_notice, which detaches pipe3, and USB continues on the USB2 port
dp_use_notice body is exactly the detach call
the vendor DWC3 core always runs phy_init on the USB3 PHY too; skipping it is a deviation to be measured, not a vendor mode
first DWC3 register read: GSNPSID at DWC3 + 0xc120; the upper half is the IP id: 0x5533 (DWC3) or 0x3331 (DWC31/32), anything else is not a valid core
GSNPSID offset and IP-id constants
GUID, then dwc3_phy_setup: GUSB2PHYCFG SUSPHY cleared, ENBLSLPM per quirk (before the PHY init)
GUSB2PHYCFG: clear SUSPHY
PHY init calls (the UTMI/eUSB sequence of phase 1-3 runs here, inside phy_init(usb2))
soft reset: DCTL.CSFTRST = 1, RUN_STOP = 0, poll CSFTRST clear (1 us steps, 1000 tries; later IP versions 10 tries x 20 ms)
soft reset body: set CSFTRST, clear RUN_STOP
soft reset returns immediately if the controller role is host (current_dr_role)
global control: GCTL scale-down cleared, clock gating per PWROPT
frame length adjustment (DT snps,quirk-frame-length-adjustment = 0x20 -> GFLADJ), reference clock period
reference clock period into GUCTL.REFCLKPER and GFLADJ (clock rate from the DT 'ref' clock)
phy_power_on for usb2 and usb3 (no-ops in the vendor PHY, see 1.09)
event buffer: GEVNTADRLO/HI = DMA address of the buffer
event buffer: GEVNTSIZ = byte length
event buffer: write back GEVNTCOUNT to clear stale events
Exynos glue GSBUSCFG0: INCR burst enable plus AXI cache types (Cacheable/Modifiable) for descriptor and data reads/writes (DWC3 >= 2.20a)
Exynos glue GCTL: SOFITPSYNC is set if the u2 free-clock quirk applies, else cleared; and cleared again when adj_sof_accuracy is set (DT exynos,adj-sof-accuracy)
DT controller quirks: frame length 0x20, no U1/U2 entry, no u2 freeclk exists, GFLADJ refclk LPM sel
board DT limits maximum-speed to super-speed; a HS-only monitor would set the DCFG speed itself

the glue's sysreg-usb sharability (IO coherency) configuration is behind `#ifdef USB_USE_IOCOHERENCY`, a macro the pinned tree never defines (absence A2); only the unrelated config symbol CONFIG_USB_USE_IOCOHERENCY=m exists
DCFG.NUMP from RAM2 depth; DCFG.IGNSTRMPP set
DEPSTARTCFG on ep0 (resource index 0): DEPCMD at ep regs, parameter via DWC3_DEPCMD_PARAM
ep0 OUT and IN enable with DEPCFG action INIT then DEPXFERCFG (1 transfer resource)
DEPCFG for control endpoints: XFER_COMPLETE_EN, ep0 also XFER_NOT_READY_EN
DEPXFERCFG: NUM_XFER_RES = 1
DEPCMD issue: write DEPCMDPAR0/1/2, then DEPCMD with CMDACT and poll until it clears (5000 tries); for HS the PHY suspend/LPM bits are cleared around it
SETUP TRB armed on ep0 OUT (8 bytes, CONTROL_SETUP), then DEPSTARTXFER with the TRB address in PAR0 (high) and PAR1 (low)
DEPSTARTXFER parameters
device interrupt enables: connect done, USB reset, disconnect, command complete, event overflow, error tick, wake, U3/L2 suspend
run: DCFG speed field from the maximum speed (HS = DWC3_DCFG_HIGHSPEED), then DCTL.RUN_STOP = 1, poll DSTS.DEVCTRLHLT clear
DCTL.RUN_STOP set (with KEEP_CONNECT cleared)
after run the host's reset appears as USBRST event (clear device address in DCFG, stop active transfers) then CONNECTDONE (DSTS.CONNECTSPD): HS and FS use ep0 maxpacket 64
on USB reset the device address is cleared
one global repeater slot: the last registered driver wins (TUSB2E11 or PTN3222)
TUSB2E11: delay 3 ms, read REV_ID, write UART_PORT1_INIT, then the DT tune list (reg/value pairs)
TUSB2E11 tune: 0x70 = 0x5d, 0x71 = 0x2e, 0x73 = 0x86, 0x79 = 0x40, 0x76 = 0x27 (board r17 DTS; the eusb_ctrl GPIO is in a disabled #if 0 branch)
PTN3222: delay 3 ms, read REV_ID, DT tune list
I2C controller hsi2c_34 at 0x110B0000 (PERIC1 USI: usi sysreg offset 0x4c, pins gpc10 0/1)

minimal_subset.step: Domain and clocks: read pd_hsi0 status; if off, the vendor power-on (CONFIGURATION bit, status wait) and the vendor cmu_init writes (HSI0 muxes, EUSB divider, user muxes, controller option, DRCG enable); enable the LINK and control Q-channels.
Vendor wrapper order for the USB2 PHY: release isolation (PMU 0x61c bit 0), enable clocks, USBCON link init, then the eUSB2 PHY initiate.
USBCON init_link: qact disables, force_qact, link_sw_rst pulse, force bvalid and vbusvalid.
Detach pipe3 (force_pipe_en, force_phystatus, force_rxelecidle, link_pclk_sel = 0) in place of the USBDP enable.
eUSB2 PHY initiate at 19.2 MHz verbatim (resets held, rptr mode, PLL dividers, tune, iddq/enable order, 10/1000/28/2500 us waits, port reset release).
DWC3 core: GUSB2PHYCFG setup, PHY init call, soft reset, GCTL/frame length/refclk, glue GSBUSCFG0 and GCTL, event buffer.
Device start: DCFG, ep0 DEPSTARTCFG/DEPCFG/DEPXFERCFG, SETUP TRB + DEPSTARTXFER, DEVTEN, speed, DCTL.RUN_STOP; then service USBRST/CONNECTDONE.

omitted.reason: SuperSpeed PHY (USBDP combo, RAM-mode firmware download): not needed for HS EP0; the pipe3 detach replaces it. Risk U6.
Repeater I2C tuning: the eUSB2 PHY expects a repeater on its pins but the tune registers only adjust eye quality; first attempt skips them (U4).
DisplayPort user muxes in the vendor cmu_init: not needed for USB, left at their state.
DTZPC SMC needs an EL3 service call; not attempted unless U2 shows the domain off.
DMA coherency is handled by placing the shared structures in non-cacheable memory (U5).

absences.claim: the macro that compiles out the vendor PHY power_on/power_off bodies is only ever tested with #ifdef and never defined in the pinned tree (so power_on is a no-op, step 1.09)
the IO-coherency macro is only tested with #ifdef and never defined in the pinned tree (step 5.18)

ladder.action: identity: touch nothing, print the run id and the rung list
ladder.stop_if: never; this is the existing stage-marker path

ladder.action: read the pd_hsi0 power state (always-on PMU): HSI0_STATUS bit 0 and the configuration word
ladder.stop_if: read faults or hangs (the 83 s watchdog ends the run); nothing in the HSI0 block has been touched yet

ladder.action: read the always-on CMU_TOP registers that feed HSI0 (mux, gate, divider of CLKCMU_HSI0_USB32DRD)
ladder.stop_if: a faulting read ends the ladder with CMU_TOP unreadable from the loader

ladder.action: domain on: read the CMU_HSI0 muxes/divider/QCH and SYSREG_HSI0 (read-only); domain off: vendor power-on, bounded wait, DTZPC SMC attempt, cmu_init writes, then the same reads
writes: only when HSI0_STATUS bit 0 read 0: PMU 0x12862000, then the vendor cmu_init writes
ladder.stop_if: status never reads 1 within the bounded wait: no USB register is touched

ladder.action: liveness of the DWC3 block: read GSNPSID
ladder.stop_if: not 0x5533xxxx / 0x3331xxxx, or a fault/hang: the block is not alive; stop

ladder.action: HS-only PHY bring-up: isolation release, USBCON init, pipe3 detach, eUSB2 PHY initiate; read back RST_CTRL/CMN_CTRL/LINKCTRL/LINK_CLKRST/UTMI_CTRL
writes: USBCON, eUSB control registers per the listed steps
ladder.stop_if: readbacks differ from what was written (a stuck bit points to a gated clock or an unpowered rail)

ladder.action: DWC3 core: GUSB2PHYCFG, soft reset, global control, frame length/refclk, GSBUSCFG0, event buffer in loader-owned non-cacheable memory
writes: DWC3 global registers per the listed steps
ladder.stop_if: CSFTRST does not clear within the bounded poll

ladder.action: device start: DCFG high speed, ep0 configuration, SETUP TRB, DEVTEN, DCTL.RUN_STOP; with a host cable attached, observe USBRST then CONNECTDONE in the event buffer
writes: DWC3 device registers per the listed steps
ladder.stop_if: no event with a host attached for a bounded time: record the DSTS and event-buffer state; do not add repeater I2C in the same run

ladder.action: EP0 vendor requests of the NAT-041 monitor: GET_INFO returns the magic and the boot id the host did not choose
ladder.stop_if: host does not see the device: the run ends by the watchdog and the screen markers of L1-L7 carry the result

unknowns.what: State of the four USB supplies (vdd075 s5_l2, vdd12 s4_l4, vdd18 l7, vdd33 l11) when the loader runs on the RECOVERY path.
unknowns.matters: A PHY started with an unpowered rail never leaves reset; there is no register in the USB block that says so.

resolve.how: Read /sys/class/regulator/*/{name,state,microvolt} on Android (read-only) to see whether the rails are on in normal Android; Android is not the loader state.
Loader reports PHY/PLL ready bits after the init; a not-ready PHY with correct clocks points to the rails.

unknowns.what: pd_hsi0 state at loader entry and whether it needs the DTZPC SMC (need_smc 0x17810204) after power-on.
unknowns.matters: Reading any CMU_HSI0/USB register of a powered-off domain can stall the bus; the PMU domain window 0x12862000 sits in the always-on PMU.

resolve.how: First loader step reads only PMU 0x12862000..0x1286201c and logs it; USB registers are touched only if the status says on. Writing the domain-on sequence is a later, separate step.

unknowns.what: CMU_TOP state of the CLKCMU_HSI0_USB32DRD mux/gate/divider (0x22b20000 + 0x10c8/0x20c4/0x18a8) and the CMU_HSI0 muxes and QCH gates.
unknowns.matters: DWC3 and the PHY clock inputs come from these; the vendor driver relies on cal-if having programmed them.

resolve.how: Read the same registers on Android through the vendor clock debug interface or a root read (inventory, read-only) to learn the running values.
Loader reads the CMU_HSI0 registers once the domain is on and logs them before changing anything.

unknowns.what: Which repeater is fitted on this board revision and whether the default (no I2C) configuration passes HS traffic.
unknowns.matters: Both TUSB2E11 (0x3e) and PTN3222 (0x4f) nodes are enabled in every board DTS and share one global slot; the DT tune values only tune signal quality.

resolve.how: Check the Android I2C bus hsi2c_34 (which address answers, and the driver bound) read-only.
First attempt runs without repeater I2C; if no enumeration, a later image adds a polled hsi2c_34 master (needs the USI sysreg and pins).

unknowns.what: DMA path: S2MPU_S0_HSI0 and the PMMU in front of the DWC3 DMA, cache coherency of the loader's MMU state, 36-bit address width.
unknowns.matters: DWC3 needs DRAM for the event buffer, TRBs and data; a blocked or incoherent DMA hangs or corrupts silently.

resolve.how: Place event buffer, TRBs and rings in one non-cacheable, loader-owned page below 4 GiB or with explicit cache maintenance; host-model it.
Loader checks the event buffer receives the first event (USBRST/CONNECTDONE) and the SETUP TRB completes; a missing event with a connected host means DMA or coherency.

unknowns.what: Whether the USB link works with the pipe3 PHY detached when the USB3 PHY was never initialised (cold), and the reference clock rate (19.2 MHz used by the vendor PHY constants; DWC3 'ref' clock rate).
unknowns.matters: The vendor core inits both PHYs always; the detach function is evidenced only for DP/USB3-off states that began with the PHY on.

resolve.how: Run the minimal subset and read GSNPSID, GHWPARAMS, GUSB2PHYCFG, DSTS, then DCTL.RUN_STOP and the events; record exactly which step first fails.

unknowns.what: PHY port selection (DT phy,gpio_phy_port = gpc7 1) and the used_phy_port the USBDP/TCA uses; irrelevant to the eUSB2 path if the combo PHY stays off.
unknowns.matters: Only the Type-C orientation for the SuperSpeed lanes.

resolve.how: Read the GPIO state on Android (read-only) for the record; not needed for the HS-only subset.

unknowns.what: How the run ends: the host monitor reads until the watchdog fires; a reboot reason into Download Mode is NAT-042.
unknowns.matters: An unattended run must end without the owner's hands.

resolve.how: Reboot-reason protocol (exynos-reboot node at PMU 0x3c00 / 0x190) specified and host-modelled.
